title: Lane departure warning and lane change assist
summary: Feedback on lane-related driver assistance centers on appreciated automatic lane changes and alerts, alongside complaints about intrusive or inaccurate lane departure behavior, while many excerpts are merely feature mentions or setup guidance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise lane change assist as natural and enjoyable and value lane departure alerts for notifying the driver.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report lane departure warnings and lane keeping as inaccurate, overly sensitive, irritating, or feeling unsafe.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention menu paths, disabling instructions, or brief references to lane departure or lane change assistant without clear evaluation.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts with this topic are undetermined, so the evaluative evidence is limited.
The topic combines lane departure warning, lane keeping, and lane change assistant, which are related but not identical features.
Several fragments are truncated or brief, limiting detail about the exact customer experience.
